subject: TAM availability roster and incident notification lanes
messages:
From: Lisa Young <lisa.young@evergreenbank.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood RFP — support coverage & incident comms

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking our RFP. Procurement and our Platform Ops team need detail on how Redwood will staff and notify for incidents if we move forward. For the questionnaire we need a clear, itemized response for the following by COB Thursday (2027-06-03):

1) TAM coverage hours (local time + timezone coverage) and primary/secondary contacts.
2) After-hours on-call rotation (weeknights/weekends) and guaranteed response SLAs for Sev1/Sev2.
3) Escalation lanes (TAM -> Eng -> Exec), typical response windows, and what triggers exec notification.
4) Notification channels and formats (email, phone, PagerDuty, SMS) and whether you support customer-managed PagerDuty integrations.
5) Incident communications cadence and templates (initial ack, hourly updates, RCA timing).
6) Evidence for audit/SOC2 (audit logs retention, access to support transcripts).

If you can attach your TAM roster and an incident-notify matrix (or point us to a single consolidated doc), that will speed our internal review. Looping Chris Evans from Platform Ops (cc).

Best,
Lisa
Lisa Young
Senior Procurement Manager
Evergreen Bank
[Attachment: Evergrn_RFP_Section5.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Young <lisa.young@evergreenbank.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-31T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood RFP — support coverage & incident comms

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear list. Attached are two artifacts: a TAM roster (redwood_tam_roster_v2.xlsx) and our incident communication playbook (incident_comm-playbook.pdf). Below is a concise, itemized response you can paste into the RFP template. If you want a single consolidated PDF for procurement, we’ll produce that by Thursday.

1) TAM coverage hours:
   - Core TAM coverage: Mon–Fri 8:00–18:00 PT (05:00–23:00 ET) with regional overlap via distributed roster.
   - Extended coverage: 24/7 on-call for Sev1/Sev2 via our on-call rotation (see attachments).
   - Timezone coverage: primary coverage for US business hours across PT/MT/CT/ET; designated night shift covers APAC overlap windows.

2) After-hours on-call rotation & SLAs:
   - Sev1 (service down/security incident): initial ack within 30 minutes, remediation/mitigation status update every 60 minutes until resolved.
   - Sev2 (degraded/high-impact): initial ack within 2 hours, updates every 2–4 hours.
   - Sev3/4: standard next-business-hour follow-up.

3) Escalation lanes & triggers:
   - Level 1: Customer-facing TAM (primary) — triage and run standard mitigation playbook (0–30m).
   - Level 2: Redwood Infra/Model Ops engineers (30m–2h) — deep troubleshooting and temporary mitigations.
   - Level 3: Product & Engineering leadership (2h+) — exec notification triggered for P1 sustained outage >60 minutes or any incident impacting regulated data flows.

4) Notification channels & integrations:
   - Supported: email, SMS, phone, PagerDuty (we support both Redwood-managed and customer-managed PagerDuty integrations), and secure webhook callbacks.
   - Formats: initial ack (email + PagerDuty alert), hourly status (email + status page link), phone escalation for P1.

5) Incident communications cadence & templates:
   - Initial ack: within SLA window (see above).
   - Status cadence: P1 hourly, P2 every 2–4 hours, postmortem within 7 business days (RCA draft within 5 business days).
   - Templates: included in incident_comm-playbook.pdf (initial-ack.template, hourly-update.template, rca.template).

6) Audit & SOC2 evidence: 
   - Support transcripts, ticket timelines, and audit logs retained for 90 days by default; extended retention available as an add-on.
   - We can provide redacted incident transcripts and a SOC2 artifact package as part of diligence.

Attachments (in this thread):
 - redwood_tam_roster_v2.xlsx (Excel, 32KB) — roster with primary/secondary TAM names, phone/PagerDuty schedules, timezone columns.
 - incident_comm-playbook.pdf (PDF, 220KB) — templates, escalation matrix, and example timelines.

Next steps: Grace — can you confirm the current night-shift overlap (APAC) and whether we should include a third-tier 24/7 engineering pager? Aditya — please confirm that we’ll provide the SOC2 artifact bundle once procurement requests it.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Success (TAM Programs)
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_tam_roster_v2.xlsx (Excel, 32KB)]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>

> Attached are two artifacts: a TAM roster and our incident communication playbook. Below is a concise, itemized response you can paste into the RFP template.

Adding specific roster + on-call details (pulled from attached roster):

- Primary TAMs (US):
  * Kimberly Park — primary TAM for Evergreen (Mon–Fri 8:00–18:00 PT) — kimberly_park@redwood.com — PagerDuty: kimberly_pd
  * Aditya Rao — secondary TAM (overlap coverage, escalation) — aditya_rao@redwood.com — PagerDuty: aditya_pd

- Night & Weekend coverage:
  * Night shift engineer (US night) covers 22:00–08:00 PT; rotation is 7 days on / 21 days off for engineers, TAM on-call rotates weekly among senior TAMs.
  * APAC overlap: we schedule one TAM shift to align with 00:00–08:00 PT to provide handoff into APAC business hours.

- Escalation contacts (for inclusion in procurement exhibit):
  1) Tier 1 TAM — kimberly_park@redwood.com (primary) / aditya_rao@redwood.com (secondary)
  2) Tier 2 Engineering — infra-oncall@redwood.com (engineer pager)
  3) Tier 3 Leadership — eng-incident-leads@redwood.com (exec on-call)

- Additional notes:
  * We support customer-managed PagerDuty; we can accept a read-only service account to forward alerts.
  * For regulated data incidents we include the CISO on P1 notifications and provide encrypted artifact transfer for evidence.

I will update the attached roster with explicit timezone columns and an annotated example notification flow and re-upload to our shared Drive link.

Grace O'Connor
Head, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
